The web page provides access to available reports and products.

Year 2070 future condition with projected climate and sea level conditions for a thirty‐year period centered at 2070 (climate period 2056‐2085) based on GCM CNRM-CM5 and emission scenario RCP 4.5.

Temperature and precipitation are developed from the downscaled model using quantile delta mapping.
